mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate is held constant for two consecutive months above 5.25%, market expectations for future rate cuts increase, lowering real discount rates and boosting equity present-value pricing, which drives a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: FOMC holds or cuts rates after a prolonged period of tightening
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the 30-day moving average of the pre-trigger period (t-test p > 0.05) in the specified horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) accompanied by a simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, which raises consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, producing a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >5% month-over-month AND UNRATE falls by >0.2 percentage points in the same month
regime_hint: Labor market transition from contraction to expansion
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >70% of similar labor-market transition events (rolling 12-month window).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in retail sales (HOUST) exceeding 2% for three consecutive months predicts stronger consumer demand, prompting firms to raise guidance and expand capital expenditures, which elevates expected future earnings and supports a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by >2% each month for three consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05) during analogous demand upswings in prior cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 3% in a month coincides with rising inflationary pressures (CPIAUCSL), prompting the Federal Reserve to signal tighter policy, which compresses growth expectations and reduces equity valuations, producing a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls by >3% AND CPIAUCSL rises by >0.3% in the same month
regime_hint: Supply shock coupled with inflation acceleration
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns remain positive during analogous supply-inflation regimes (rolling 12-month comparison).

mechanism_narrative: Persistent declines in inflation (CPIAUCSL < 296.5) for four consecutive months, despite steady GDP growth, suggest the Fed is likely to hold rates steady, reducing policy uncertainty and supporting a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than the 30-day moving average during comparable low-inflation holds (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in job openings (RSAFS) below 7 million coinciding with a rise in layoffs (PAYEMS) indicates a softening labor market, which increases perceived risk and dampens equity risk appetite, producing a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < 7 AND PAYEMS falls by >10% in the same month
regime_hint: Labor market cooling with rising layoffs
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically negative (t-test p > 0.05) during analogous labor-market cooling events.

mechanism_narrative: A one-time surge in consumer confidence (indirect proxy via HOUST > 1500 and UNRATE < 4%) predicts a short-term boost in discretionary spending and corporate investment, which elevates expected earnings and supports a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 1500 AND UNRATE < 4% in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not positive in >60% of analogous confidence rebounds (rolling 6-month window).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) combined with a decline in new home sales (HOUST < 1200) signals a dual supply shock, which elevates recession risk and compresses equity valuations, producing a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 100 AND HOUST < 1200 in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically negative (t-test p > 0.05) during comparable supply contractions without housing weakness.
